authorization_source: user instruction: 'do it' in direct response to the proposed narrow C6.1 evaluation-only recovery plan (2026-08-31 America/Vancouver)
approved_statement: I authorize one evaluation-only recovery of the already-trained ZERO.5 C6.1 seed-0 checkpoint. The recovery may download the exact private checkpoint pair and completed training log bound by the recovery contract, run the unchanged frozen validation and same-checkpoint bridge-off ablation, cache hash-bound atomic evaluation results, and emit the original C6.1 decision record. It may use one on-demand c6i.4xlarge instance in us-east-1 for at most 9,000 seconds and $1.70, with 30-second private state sync and automatic termination. It authorizes zero training updates and no independent retry, promotion, replication, checkpoint publication, corpus publication, or sealed-test access.
